title: Dandadan Creator Returns With New Look At Beloved Characters Ahead of Season 3
content: Dandadan Season 3 is still a while away, and it’s going to adapt the manga’s best arc. Written and illustrated by Yukinobu Tatsu, the beloved Shonen Jump+ manga released its anime adaptation in Fall 2024. The anime returned with a new season in Summer 2025, six months after the first season’s finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Spin-off Manga 'Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaiou wa Isekai Tensei shitemo Ikkou ni Kamawan!' Gets Anime Adaptation
content: An anime adaptation of Daisuke Ihara and Eiji Mutsui 's Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaiou wa Isekai Tensei shitemo Ikkou ni Kamawan! spin-off manga was announced on Monday, revealing the announcement promotional video. Animation studio TMS Entertainment is producing the anime.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Baki Gaiden: Kaioh Retsu Isekai Spin-Off Gets TV Anime Adaptation
content: The Baki spin-off manga BAKI GAIDEN: KAIOH RETSU Doesn’t Mind Getting Isekai’d is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. The spin-off follows Retsu Kaioh after the conclusion of his battle against Musashi Miyamoto in BAKI-DOU .
author: Anime Corner

title: It’s Official, Baki Is Getting Its Own Isekai Anime in 2027 – Watch the Trailer
content: The massively popular Baki the Grappler franchise has officially announced it’s getting its own Isekai anime release next year, and the first teaser trailer is helping to show it all off.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump Cancels Yet Another Major 2026 Series After Less Than Six Months
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has cancelled its eight major series this year, and this one hasn’t even made it to the six month mark before it got the axe. Shonen Jump has had a much better run this year than it did in 2025, but there have still been a number of major titles that have been prematurely…

title: Medalist Anime Film's Teaser Reveals February 19 Opening
content: Kadokawa revealed on Sunday a teaser trailer, teaser visual, character visuals, and the February 19 opening date for the upcoming anime film based on Tsurumaikada 's Olympic ice-skating manga Medalist . Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga, and it describes the story: Tsukasa, whose dreams were crushed.

title: Mushoku Tensei "Turning Point 4" Revealed as Title of Season 3 Episode 11
content: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 has officially confirmed “Turning Point 4” as the title of its upcoming episode, Episode 11. As the name suggests, it means a turning point for Rudeus, and the previous episodes were all some of the most important ones in the anime. The new episode will premiere next Sunday on September 6.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Creator Returns With New Look at Yuta Ahead of Season 4
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is now hard at work for its return with Season 4 of the anime, and the creator behind it all has returned with a cool new look at Yuta Okkotsu and Rika to help celebrate. Jujutsu Kaisen originally came to an end with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine back in 2024 .
author: ComicBook
